# 50 Good Summers

> An original feature screenplay by Eric R. Gutierrez / Desert Rich Productions about time, legacy, and the radical decision to live fully. A man with only a handful of summers left sets out to transform his remaining time into a legacy of meaning. Third draft complete (118 pages). Worldwide rights available, including remake, sequel, and television rights.

50 Good Summers is a drama set against the American Southwest, presented for acquisition by producers, directors, and financiers.

## Key facts

- Title: 50 Good Summers
- Format: Original feature screenplay (118 pages, third draft)
- Logline: When a man learns he has only a handful of summers left, he sets out to transform his remaining time into a legacy of meaning — before the sun sets on his final season.
- Status: In active development — target principal photography summer 2027
- Rights: Worldwide, including remake, sequel, and television
- Contact: sales@desertrich.com
